text:
Type: typographic New York city poster
Use: wall decoration above a sofa, a desk or a bed; living room, home office, bedroom, teen room
Style: industrial, retro, contemporary
Materials: printed panel with a distressed, weathered print finish
Colors: navy blue, white, grey, turquoise accents
Shape: tall narrow portrait panel stacked with blocks of street sign lettering and city names, a turquoise one way arrow, graphic and busy, medium visual weight
Feel: urban, bold, energetic, nostalgic
Goes with: brick walls, black metal, leather, denim blues, dark wood; industrial lofts, urban or retro rooms

product.name: KOPPARFALL
product.description: You can personalise your home with artwork that expresses your style.
